derivation: simpa using AlgebraTensorModule.map_tmul (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[A] M) f m n
explanation: `AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor A M f` is *defined* as `map LinearMap.id f` (Tower.lean, line 233), and the general computation rule `TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.map_tmul` (Tower.lean, line 188) states `map f g (m ⊗ₜ n) = f m ⊗ₜ g n`. Instantiating `P := M` and `f := LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[A] M` (and `g := f`) gives exactly `lTensor A M f (m ⊗ₜ n) = m ⊗ₜ f n`, after unfolding the definition of `lTensor` and reducing `id m`; the current proof is just `rfl` (definitional unfolding of `lTensor`), so it does not apply `map_tmul` by name. Note the analogous non-heterobasic fact `LinearMap.lTensor_tmul` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/TensorProduct/Map.lean, line 624) is about the different definition `LinearMap.lTensor`, which agrees with `AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor A M f` only at the level of the underlying function (via `coe_lTensor`); the heterobasic `lTensor` is an `A`-linear map, so that is not literally the same statement, whereas `map_tmul` with `id` is exactly this result.
